data.revised_prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: production-ready mobile game art for a portrait Cocos Creator cat-themed 2048 game
Primary request: create a coherent original visual system that feels playful, artistic, collectible, and immediately readable on a phone screen
Style/medium: premium 2D cartoon game illustration, bold graphic shapes, expressive hand-painted color blocking, subtle paper-grain texture, polished editorial character design, slightly asymmetrical handmade charm
Art direction: rounded silhouettes, large simple shapes, confident contour lines, restrained highlights, soft upper-left lighting, gentle lower-right grounding shadow when appropriate
Color palette: warm ivory interface neutrals with coral, teal, mustard, leaf green, raspberry, sky blue, and violet accents; avoid a one-note palette
Mobile readability: every icon and character must remain recognizable at 64-80 px; simplify tiny details and preserve strong silhouettes
Consistency: use the same line weight, eye design, proportions, lighting direction, and painterly texture across every asset
Constraints: original artwork only; no text, numbers, letters, logos, trademarks, watermark, QR code, mockup frame, UI screenshot, photorealism, anime rendering, plastic 3D render, excessive gloss, thin sketch lines, clutter, or busy micro-details

One ultimate genesis aurora cat for the Lv12 tile, the final and most prestigious cat in the same collection. Exactly one full-body cat sitting upright and facing mostly forward, centered and fully visible, with a compact rounded body, round ears, tiny glossy dark eyes, a warm peaceful expression, and an unmistakable strong silhouette at small size. A luminous pearly ivory body blends into deep indigo ears, back, and curled tail with broad clean aurora blocks of coral pink, teal, violet, and gold; add a simple large eight-point star mark centered on the forehead and a few broad silver-gold constellation marks on the chest. Place one elegant thin circular eclipse halo behind the head and shoulders, clearly separated from the body, with sparse large aurora star points and a soft silver edge. Make the silhouette feel complete and special without adding clothing or accessories. Use a confident charcoal-to-silver outer contour, soft upper-left lighting, subtle hand-painted paper-grain texture, and restrained luminous glow. Keep details broad and legible at 64-80 px. Preserve generous transparent padding around the complete silhouette. No floor, scenery, props, crown, wings, clothing, jewelry, text, numbers, letters, logo, watermark, multiple cats, duplicate body parts, clipped ears or tail, thin fur strands, busy star fields, neon bloom, photorealism, anime, or plastic 3D rendering.
